name: agy-game-studio
description: Unified 2D game development plugin for Google Antigravity, Go, and Ebitengine bundling 9 skills (vibe-game-developer, game-design, ebitengineer, sprite-design, procedural-sfx, procedural-music, nano-banana, lyria, game-dev-studio), a 10-tool Go MCP server (sound_presets, music_synthesize, music_validate, sfx_synthesize, sprite_inspect, sprite_compile, sprite_normalize, sprite_extract_palette, image_generate, music_generate), and the Game Dev Studio 60 FPS WASM Playtest UI (with 10s DVR GIF bug annotation).
suggestedPrompts: Design and build an Ebitengine 2D game in Go, then open the Game Dev Studio Playtest panel to run it at 60 FPS and capture a 10s DVR GIF bug report
Compose procedural .music or .sfx audio, or generate a track with Lyria and bake 44.1 kHz stereo WAV files for Go using the game-studio MCP tools
Generate game sprites with Nano Banana, normalize chroma-key sprite sheets, or compile .sprite and .aseprite animations using the game-studio MCP tools
